items.q: What is the starting rate for a single video?
items.a: Pricing depends on duration, graphic density, and raw footage volume. Base long-form YouTube editing starts from $200. A firm quote is provided after reviewing your brief and footage sample.

items.q: What is the typical turnaround timeline?
items.a: A standard 10–15 minute video takes 3 to 7 business days. An initial review draft is typically delivered on days 2–3 for feedback.

items.q: How do we transfer raw video files?
items.a: Via Google Drive, Dropbox, Telegram, or any cloud host of your choice. High-speed direct transfer protocols are supported for massive archives.

items.q: How many revision cycles are included?
items.a: Every project includes 2 full rounds of timestamped revisions. This is more than enough because the structure is validated during the initial draft.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Yes, I regularly collaborate with creators in the US, Europe, and CIS. Payments are accepted via crypto (USDT) and international bank transfers.
